drafter.private_reasoning: The draft omits the core economic term and leaves the release and confidentiality provisions overly broad. Propose a firm opening amount and clear payment mechanics, condition the release on full payment, and add customary confidentiality exceptions without disclosing the client's confidential minimum.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for the first draft. To keep the matter moving, we have added a proposed settlement amount and payment mechanics, clarified that the release becomes effective only upon full payment, and included customary exceptions to confidentiality. We are happy to discuss any comments promptly.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 6,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within five business days after the Effective Date. Defendant shall be responsible for any required tax reporting with respect to the payment; Plaintiff shall be responsible for Plaintiff’s own tax obligations.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, and their respective officers, directors, employees, and agents from all claims Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to Plaintiff’s employment or its termination, through the date Plaintiff signs this Agreement. This release does not waive claims to enforce this Agreement or claims that cannot legally be waived. Defendant releases Plaintiff from any claims arising out of or relating to Plaintiff’s employment or its termination through the date Defendant signs this Agreement, excluding claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the existence and terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, tax advisors, immediate family, insurers, or other professional advisors who are bound to keep the information confidential, or as required by law, regulation, court order, or to enforce this Agreement. The parties may also make disclosures necessary for tax, accounting, or financial reporting purposes.
